tasks.title: End-to-End M1 Demonstrator Integration and Verification
tasks.description: Complete demonstrator with synthetic intro ADF and freeware fixtures.

tasks.title: Amiga Floppy Filesystem (OFS/FFS) Parser in @rgme/core
tasks.description: Pure TypeScript parser to read Amiga ADF disk images: decode bootblock, root block, volume name, file entries, directory tree, and file contents.
acceptanceCriteria: AdfParser class in @rgme/core capable of reading raw 880KB ADF buffers
Parses volume label, creation timestamp, and detects OFS vs FFS filesystem variants
Extracts directory tree, file list, and file byte contents without native C dependencies
Reads rgme-scene-intro.adf and extracts disk header/banner cleanly
100% unit tests in @rgme/core verifying parser with synthetic ADF buffers

tasks.title: Virtual Floppy Drive Subsystem (DF0:-DF3:) & Step Sound Synth
tasks.description: Virtual floppy drive controller managing multiple drives (DF0: to DF3:), track stepper motor states, disk ejection/insertion events, and Web Audio mechanical drive sound simulation.
acceptanceCriteria: FloppyController managing virtual drives DF0:, DF1:, DF2:, DF3:
State machine tracking drive motor (on/off), current cylinder (0-79), read/write activity
AmigaFloppyAudioSynth generating authentic mechanical drive head step, seek, and track-0 click sounds via Web Audio API
Multi-disk swap UI component in @rgme/web allowing users to switch disks (e.g. Disk 1 to Disk 2) with visual drive LED activity
Unit tests in @rgme/core verifying drive state machine and disk swap events

tasks.title: Save State Persistence Engine with Canvas Thumbnails
tasks.description: IndexedDB-backed save-state management supporting slots 1-10 with visual canvas thumbnail snapshots, disk association, export/import (.rgmesave), and instant restore.
acceptanceCriteria: SaveStateManager supporting slots 1-10 backed by browser IndexedDB
Each save state captures memory/runtime snapshot, disk SHA-256, timestamp, and visual PNG thumbnail
Web UI Save/Load drawer with thumbnail cards, slot switcher, and timestamp badges
Save state export and import functionality
Unit and integration tests verifying IndexedDB operations and mock adapter restore

tasks.title: Hardware Gamepad API Subsystem with Auto-Mapping
tasks.description: HTML5 Gamepad API integration auto-detecting physical controllers (Xbox, PlayStation, 8BitDo, retro USB) and mapping them to Amiga Joystick 1/2 and Mouse.
acceptanceCriteria: GamepadManager polling HTML5 Gamepad API with connection/disconnection lifecycle
Standard mapping translating D-Pad/Left-Stick and Face Buttons to Amiga directions and Fire
Live button visualizer in ControllerHUD indicating active physical presses in real time
Configurable button remap modal in @rgme/web
Unit tests verifying gamepad event loop and translation to Amiga input events

tasks.title: High-Fidelity WebGL CRT Shader & Display Profile Pipeline
tasks.description: WebGL post-processing pipeline for the Canvas Viewport implementing authentic PAL scanlines, shadow mask/aperture grille, curvature, and phosphor bloom.
acceptanceCriteria: WebGL CRT shader renderer wrapping the canvas viewport in @rgme/web
Preset profiles: 'Authentic PAL (Clean)', 'Trinitron CRT', 'Commodore 1084S (Curved)', 'Retro Arcade Grille'
User controls for scanline intensity, bloom glow, and barrel distortion toggle
Graceful fallback to 2D CSS pixel-perfect rendering if WebGL is unavailable
Visual test ensuring shader renders without throwing WebGL context errors

tasks.title: Persistent Browser Library Shelf & Collection Manager
tasks.description: Browser IndexedDB library preserving scanned ADFs, profiles, and metadata across sessions with search, filtering by Chipset/Rights Class, and 1-click launch.
acceptanceCriteria: GameLibraryStore in IndexedDB saving user-dropped ADFs and resolved GameProfiles
Library shelf view in @rgme/web displaying game cards with badges (Rights Class, Chipset, Year)
Search and filter controls by Title, Rights Status (Cleared vs Local-Only), and Platform
1-click launch button mounting selected game into Viewport and DF0:
Full test suite verifying library storage and retrieval

tasks.title: Real WebAssembly Amiga Host Adapter
tasks.description: WasmAmigaAdapter host layer (contract, loader, PAL timing model, media mount) with a deterministic reference core; runtime switch Mock/WASM. No instruction-level 68000 emulation.
acceptanceCriteria: WasmAmigaAdapter host layer (contract, loader, PAL timing model, media mount) with a deterministic reference core; runtime switch Mock/WASM. No instruction-level 68000 emulation.

tasks.title: C64 and Mega Drive Reference Runtimes
tasks.description: D64 and Mega Drive ROM parsers, C64/Genesis reference adapters with SID/FM-style synthesis and fixtures. Reference runtimes, not CPU emulation.
acceptanceCriteria: D64 and Mega Drive ROM parsers, C64/Genesis reference adapters with SID/FM-style synthesis and fixtures. Reference runtimes, not CPU emulation.

tasks.title: Chain-of-Title Explorer
tasks.description: Interactive provenance timeline with evidence and class explanations; unverified links are marked, never invented.
acceptanceCriteria: Interactive provenance timeline with evidence and class explanations; unverified links are marked, never invented.

tasks.title: Standalone Portable Exporter
tasks.description: rgme export + web export; rights gate decides between single-file player (cleared) and BYOG package without game data.
acceptanceCriteria: rgme export + web export; rights gate decides between single-file player (cleared) and BYOG package without game data.

tasks.title: Pure TypeScript IPF / CAPS Floppy Decoder in @rgme/core
tasks.description: Decode Interchangeable Preservation Format (.ipf) containers: parse CAPS, FDI, TRCK, and DATA chunks to reconstruct MFM track streams and extract Amiga floppy sectors.
acceptanceCriteria: IpfParser in @rgme/core capable of reading raw .ipf container buffers
Decodes container headers, track descriptor tables, and MFM sector streams
Extracts standard 512-byte Amiga sectors from decoded IPF tracks
Integrates with AdfParser / FloppyController to seamlessly mount .ipf files into DF0:-DF3:
Unit tests in @rgme/core verifying parsing against synthetic and sample IPF chunks

tasks.title: In-Browser Motorola 68000 CPU Execution Core in @rgme/core
tasks.description: Lightweight Motorola 68000 CPU execution core with memory bus and register file, capable of executing genuine Amiga bootblock code, copperlist setups, and arithmetic instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: M68kCpu in @rgme/core with 8 data registers (D0-D7), 8 address registers (A0-A7), PC, and SR
Implements core 68000 opcodes: MOVE, LEA, PEA, ADD, SUB, CMP, BRA, BSR, RTS, JMP, JSR, NOP, RESET
Executes Amiga bootblock code from sector 0: sets memory base, writes to Custom Chip registers (0xdff000)
Fulfills the WasmAmigaAdapter / RuntimeAdapter contract for real instruction-level execution
Unit tests in @rgme/core running real m68k test vectors and verifying register/flag states

tasks.title: Amiga ProTracker / SoundTracker (.mod) 4-Channel Audio Engine
tasks.description: Native 4-channel ProTracker engine: parse M.K. / 4CHN module format, Paula 8-bit signed PCM audio synthesis, hardware period-to-frequency pitching, volume and effect commands (Arpeggio, Vibrato, Portamento).
acceptanceCriteria: ModPlayer in @rgme/core parsing standard 4-channel Amiga ProTracker modules (.mod)
Simulates Paula stereo separation (channels 0 & 3 to Left, 1 & 2 to Right)
Implements core ProTracker effects: 0 (Arpeggio), 1/2 (Portamento), C (Set Volume), D (Pattern Break), F (Set Speed)
Plays bundled retro tribute MOD file with Web Audio API
Unit tests verifying MOD header parsing, pattern decoding, and sample playback math

tasks.title: Multi-Disk .m3u Playlist Engine & In-Game Floppy Swapper
tasks.description: Support .m3u playlists (matching IPF preservation sets), with automated disk swapping triggers and hotkey/UI disk selector.
acceptanceCriteria: M3uPlaylistParser in @rgme/core parsing .m3u files and grouping multi-disk sets
Floppy HUD in @rgme/web displays active disk (e.g. 'Disk 1 of 11') with quick-swap selector
Hotkeys (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+1..9) or button click immediately swaps disk in DF0: with drive click audio
Unit tests verifying playlist parsing and swap events

tasks.title: Commodore 1084S Retro Monitor Bezel & Fullscreen Nostalgia Experience
tasks.description: Commodore 1084S monitor bezel overlay wrapping the WebGL CRT canvas with authentic texture, power LED, power switch toggle, and fullscreen mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Commodore 1084S monitor bezel component framing the canvas viewport
Interactive power LED (glow green/amber) and power switch (toggles power off/on with CRT phosphor shrink effect)
Degauss button triggering screen shake and electromagnetic degauss color flash effect
Fullscreen toggle fitting monitor bezel or filling screen with aspect ratio lock
Responsive scaling maintaining 4:3 PAL display geometry
